items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Now, last night they had Lawrence Welk. Did you hear him on Channel Five? ... I was listening to them all by myself.

ctx.x: Well, have you changed your mind at all about bebop or modern jazz?
No, because -- you know why? The modern bands are coming back. Now, last night they had Lawrence Welk. Did you hear him on Channel Five?
